1 # InkOS — Post-12-Sprint Deep QA Audit 2 3 **Date:** 2026-04-17 4 **Reviewer:** Sage 5 **Scope:** Full codebase (824 TS/TSX files, 225 API routes, 6 migrations) 6 7 **Total issues:** 100 8 **By severity:** 17 Critical / 45 Major / 38 Minor 9 **By category:** Security 14 · Bug 23 · UX 11 · A11y 12 · Perf 9 · Types 5 · Copy 5 · Consistency 10 · Mobile 3 · Dark Mode 2 · Infra 6 10 11 --- 12 13 ## Critical (must fix before launch) 14 15 1. [Bug] `lib/queue.ts:8` — `enqueueJob` is a no-op stub, yet 15+ production routes depend on it (marketing sends, AI design processing, tax form PDFs/emails, Google Calendar sync, consent PDFs, Dodo webhook emails, booking reminders). All these features silently fail in production. **Fix:** wire BullMQ + Redis or switch to a real job backend before any customer onboards. 16 17 2. [Bug] `lib/email/resend.ts:28-36` — `sendEmail` is a no-op stub that never calls Resend. `FROM_EMAIL`, `REPLY_TO`, and the 5 React Email templates in `lib/email/templates/` are unused. No transactional emails send at all. **Fix:** Restore real Resend client, call from webhook + queue workers. 18 19 3. [Security] `lib/rate-limit.ts:18-31` — every exported limiter (`apiRatelimit`, `authedRatelimit`, `loginRatelimit`, `signupRatelimit`, `publicBookingCreateRatelimit`, etc.) always returns `{ success: true, remaining: 9999 }`. 225 API routes have zero effective rate limiting. Brute-force, signup spam, and DoS are unmitigated. **Fix:** Re-integrate Upstash Ratelimit with real Redis credentials. 20 21 4. [Security] `sentry.client.config.ts` + `sentry.server.config.ts` exist but `instrumentation.ts` and `instrumentation-client.ts` at project root are **missing**. Per CLAUDE.md these are required. Browser errors never reach Sentry. **Fix:** Create both `instrumentation.ts` (server init) and `instrumentation-client.ts` (browser init) re-exporting the existing configs. 22 23 5. [Security] `app/api/auth/signup/route.ts:46` — `email_confirm: true` is set unconditionally on signup, bypassing email verification. Anyone can register any email and immediately access the platform. **Fix:** Set `email_confirm: false` and implement the verify-email flow. 24 25 6. [Security] `components/auth/LoginForm.tsx:54` — `redirectedFrom` param from query string is used as redirect target with no validation. Attacker can craft `/login?redirectedFrom=https://evil.com` → user lands on phishing site after login. **Fix:** Validate `redirectTo` starts with `/` and does not contain `//` or protocol. 26 27 7. [Security] `app/(auth)/callback/route.ts:12,65` — `next` query param used as redirect target with no validation (same open redirect issue, on the OAuth callback). **Fix:** Same validation as above. 28 29 8. [Security] `app/api/tax-forms/[id]/reveal-ssn/route.ts:72-82` — SSN decryption is **stubbed** and returns the literal string `'XXX-XX-XXXX (decryption requires DB pgcrypto setup)'`. UI believes a decrypt occurred. Feature is broken for its stated purpose. **Fix:** Implement pgcrypto-backed decrypt or disable the route. 30 31 9. [Bug] `app/api/payroll/tax-forms/[id]/reveal-ssn/route.ts:12` — delegates via `NextResponse.rewrite(url)` inside a route handler POST. Route handlers do not execute rewrites — the response is a rewrite directive that never invokes the target handler, so the endpoint is effectively broken. **Fix:** Inline the logic or `fetch()` the target route with headers forwarded. 32 33 10. [Bug] `app/api/schedule/apply-template/route.ts:73` — returns HTTP 501 with message `"Custom templates not yet available — run Sprint 8 DB migration"` even though the migration (`20260417230000_schedule_templates.sql`) exists and is applied. Users get a spurious "not available" error for working functionality. **Fix:** Query `schedule_templates` table and remove the 501 branch. 34 35 11. [Security] `app/api/webhooks/dodo/route.ts` — webhook registers events but the downstream `enqueueJob` calls for `send-email` (subscription renewal, payment failed, etc.) are no-op stubs. Customers never receive billing emails after Dodo events. **Fix:** Same as #1 (queue must be real). 36 37 12. [Bug] `app/(app)/consent-forms/templates/[id]/page.tsx:1-8` — the template detail page is a stub returning `

Detail view — future sprint

`. Clicking any template in the templates list lands users on a blank "future sprint" screen. **Fix:** Implement template detail/view route or remove the link from the list. 38 39 13. [Security] `app/api/billing/cancel/route.ts:50` + `app/api/billing/resume/route.ts:50` — both use `(dodo.subscriptions as unknown as {...}).update(...)` type-laundering. If Dodo's SDK signature changes, TypeScript won't catch it and customers could be silently mis-billed. **Fix:** Use the real SDK type or pin an interface. 40 41 14. [Security] `app/api/auth/signup/route.ts:11` — `password: z.string().min(8)` has no complexity requirements (no upper/lower/number check) and no max length. Allows trivial passwords (`12345678`) and unbounded-length DoS passwords. **Fix:** Add `.regex()` for complexity plus `.max(72)` (bcrypt's effective max). 42 43 15. [Security] `next.config.ts:27-42` — no Content-Security-Policy header configured. STS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy are present; CSP is missing. OWASP A05. **Fix:** Add a `Content-Security-Policy` header (start with `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-…'`). 44 45 16. [Bug] `.env.local` checked into repo working tree (not tracked via git — verified in `.gitignore`) contains service-role key and DB password. If anyone accidentally runs `git add -f .env.local` those secrets would ship to GitHub. Also secrets share the workspace — very brittle. **Fix:** Rotate + use Supabase Vault or Doppler / 1Password CLI. 46 47 17. [Bug] `components/ai/ShareDesignPage.tsx:121-123` — customer-facing "Book a consultation" CTA is wired to `window.alert()` with a TODO comment. Public-share pages (an acquisition surface) look broken. **Fix:** Link to `/book/[studioSlug]` and remove the TODO. 48 49 ## Major (fix in first post-launch sprint) 50 51 18. [Security] `proxy.ts` does not include the rate limiter for public booking routes (`/book/[studioSlug]`) — only the session refresh runs. Combined with #3, public pages have zero rate limits. **Fix:** Put an IP-limited bucket in front of anonymous booking endpoints. 52 53 19. [Bug] `app/api/admin/studios/[id]/impersonate/route.ts:60-73` — generates a magiclink via `generateLink({ type: 'magiclink' })` but this link is **sent via email by Supabase** if email is configured, AND also returns `action_link` to the admin UI. Admin clicking the link logs them in as the owner and the owner simultaneously gets an unexpected login email. **Fix:** Add `skip_email=true` where supported, or document the side-effect. 54 55 20. [Security] `app/api/admin/studios/[id]/delete/route.ts:48-52` — audit log is written **before** the delete, but the delete may fail after the audit entry exists. Creates false audit trail. **Fix:** Log after successful delete, or use a single SQL transaction. 56 57 21. [Bug] `app/api/reach/registry/route.ts:11-17` — Zod schema uses `ink_brand`, `ink_color`, `ink_product_code` but DB uses `brand`, `color`, `product_code`. The server manually remaps in the POST handler, but the GET query `.order('brand', …)` and the client form all use different field names. Payload shape inconsistency is a maintenance landmine. **Fix:** Unify naming — preferably match DB. 58 59 22. [Security] `app/api/admin/studios/[id]/ban/route.ts:14` — `ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') ?? 'anon'` — spoofable header used for rate-limit key. Use `lib/rate-limit/get-client-ip.ts` (cf-connecting-ip first). **Fix:** Replace raw header reads with `getClientIp(req)` (22 similar occurrences across admin routes). 60 61 23. [Bug] `app/api/reports/clients/route.ts:25,64` — typo `nintyDaysAgo` (should be `ninetyDaysAgo`). Two occurrences, semantic-only but will resurface in code search. **Fix:** rename. 62 63 24. [Types] `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true` is on, but 80+ `as unknown as` casts exist (see grep of `lib/supabase/**` and many routes). Each cast bypasses type safety to work around out-of-date generated `Database` types. **Fix:** Run `pnpm supabase gen types typescript --linked` to refresh types and delete the TODO casts. 64 65 25. [Bug] `app/api/schedule/templates/route.ts:23` — `TemplateRow` interface is manually re-declared because generated types don't include `schedule_templates`. The table exists in migration `20260417230000_schedule_templates.sql`. **Fix:** regenerate types; 7 similar TODOs exist in other routes. 66 67 26. [Consistency] `hooks/useIsMobile.ts` and `hooks/use-mobile.ts` are duplicate hooks with identical intent but different file names, breakpoints (default vs 768 arg), and event strategies (matchMedia vs resize). Import site determines which wins. **Fix:** Consolidate to one — prefer `useIsMobile.ts`, delete the other. 68 69 27. [Consistency] `components/shared/BulkActionBar.tsx` and `components/clients/BulkActionsBar.tsx` — two distinct bulk-action bar components with overlapping API. **Fix:** Keep the generic one; port clients' special cases as props. 70 71 28. [Perf] `components/admin/billing/MrrDashboard.tsx:4-14` — imports `recharts` statically. Consumed from `app/admin/billing/AdminBillingClient.tsx:14,19` also statically. Recharts is ~200KB gzipped and ships to every admin user on every page. **Fix:** `next/dynamic(() => import(…), { ssr: false })` like the reports client already does. 72 73 29. [Perf] `components/admin/billing/LtvHistogram.tsx:12` — static recharts import. Same fix as #28. 74 75 30. [Perf] `app/(app)/artists/[id]/page.tsx` is 746 lines of `'use client'` — the entire artist detail page (tabs, forms, modals, schedule editor, commission card, payroll card) is one massive client bundle. **Fix:** Split into server components + tab-lazy client islands. 76 77 31. [Perf] `app/(app)/artists/schedules/page.tsx` — 661 lines, `'use client'`, imports FullCalendar-adjacent logic, date-fns, and multiple modals. First-load cost is enormous. **Fix:** Convert top-level data fetch to server; lazy-load modals. 78 79 32. [Perf] `app/(app)/settings/services/page.tsx` — 565 lines, `'use client'`. Heavy form, drag-and-drop (@dnd-kit), zod, react-hook-form — all loaded on settings entry. **Fix:** Dynamic-load the editor drawer; keep list server-rendered. 80 81 33. [Perf] `app/(app)/dev/design/DesignShowcase.tsx` — **2,448 lines**, gated by `is_platform_admin` at the parent page, but the client bundle still exists in `.next` output and increases build size. Imports recharts directly. **Fix:** Move behind `next/dynamic` with `loading: null` or exclude from production build via env check. 82 83 34. [Perf] `lighthouserc.json:9-15` — LHCI runs against `/dashboard`, `/calendar`, `/clients`, `/appointments`, `/reports`, `/settings/profile`, `/admin` without auth. All redirect to `/login` so scores measure the login page repeatedly. **Fix:** Use Playwright-authed storage state or test only public routes + an authed fixture. 84 85 35. [Perf] `components/calendar/CalendarView.tsx:4-8` — all 4 FullCalendar plugins imported statically. `dayGridPlugin`, `timeGridPlugin`, `interactionPlugin`, `listPlugin` plus `@fullcalendar/react` is ~250KB. Already dynamic-loaded at `app/(app)/calendar/_components/CalendarPageClient.tsx:15`, but the inner static imports negate tree-shaking per-view. **Fix:** Lazy-load per-view plugin. 86 87 36. [Bug] `app/api/admin/studios/[id]/impersonate/route.ts:69` — `expiresAt` is a display-only advisory string; real Supabase magiclink TTL is the project default (1 hour). Admin UI shows "expires in 15 minutes" but link is actually valid 4x longer. **Fix:** Either enforce TTL server-side or correct the UI copy. 88 89 37. [A11y] `components/shared/DataState.tsx:60-63` — spinner has `aria-busy="true"` on parent but the Loader2 inside is missing `aria-hidden="true"` and the parent has no `role="status"`. Screen readers silently read the Loader2 text node. **Fix:** Add `aria-hidden` on icon + `role="status"` on parent. 90 91 38. [A11y] 40+ Loader2 spinners across the codebase (see `components/commissions/*`, `components/billing/*`, `components/ai/*`) lack `aria-hidden="true"`. Each time a form submits, screen readers announce "img img img" or try to read the element. **Fix:** Global codemod — every `` should be `aria-hidden="true"`. 92 93 39. [A11y] `components/ui/skeleton.tsx` — no `aria-busy`, no `role="status"`, no `aria-label`. Loading states across 24 `loading.tsx` files are silent to screen readers. **Fix:** Add `role="status"` + `aria-live="polite"` + `aria-label="Loading"` to the primitive. 94 95 40. [A11y] `components/ui/combobox.tsx:91-95` — inner "clear" is a `` nested inside a button trigger. Nested interactive elements fail axe-core and break Base UI's focus trap. **Fix:** Move the clear outside the trigger or make it a `button` sibling. 96 97 41. 1	import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
2	import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
3	
4	/**
5	 * OAuth callback handler (PKCE + OAuth code exchange).
6	 *
7	 * Supabase redirects here after Google OAuth and password reset flows.
8	 * Exchanges the code for a session, then redirects to the appropriate page.
9	 */
10	export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
11	  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url)
12	  const code = searchParams.get('code')
13	  // Validate redirect target — prevent open-redirect (QA issue #7)
14	  const rawNext = searchParams.get('next') ?? '/dashboard'
15	  const next = rawNext.startsWith('/') && !rawNext.startsWith('//') && !rawNext.includes(':')
16	    ? rawNext
17	    : '/dashboard'
18	  const error = searchParams.get('error')
19	  const errorDescription = searchParams.get('error_description')
20	
21	  // Handle OAuth errors from Supabase
22	  if (error ?? errorDescription) {
23	    const params = new URLSearchParams({ error: errorDescription ?? error ?? 'OAuth error' })
24	    return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/login?${params.toString()}`)
25	  }
26	
27	  if (!code) {
28	    return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/login?error=Missing+authorization+code`)
29	  }
30	
31	  const supabase = await createClient()
32	  const { error: exchangeError } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code)
33	
34	  if (exchangeError) {
35	    const params = new URLSearchParams({ error: exchangeError.message })
36	    return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/login?${params.toString()}`)
37	  }
38	
39	  // Check if the user needs onboarding (no locations set up yet)
40	  const {
41	    data: { user },
42	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
43	
44	  if (user) {
45	    const { data: member } = await supabase
46	      .from('studio_members')
47	      .select('studio_id')
48	      .eq('user_id', user.id)
49	      .single()
50	
51	    if (member) {
52	      const { count } = await supabase
53	        .from('locations')
54	        .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
55	        .eq('studio_id', member.studio_id)
56	
57	      // No locations = new user who needs onboarding
58	      if (count === 0) {
59	        return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/onboarding`)
60	      }
61	    } else {
62	      // No studio membership — user needs onboarding
63	      return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/onboarding`)
64	    }
65	  }
66	
67	  return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}${next}`)
68	}
69

1	import { type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
2	import { z } from 'zod'
3	import { createServiceRoleClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
4	import { signupRatelimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
5	import { getClientIp } from '@/lib/rate-limit/get-client-ip'
6	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
7	import { slugify } from '@/lib/utils'
8	
9	const bodySchema = z.object({
10	  email: z.string().email('Enter a valid email'),
11	  // QA #14: complexity + max length (bcrypt effective max is 72 bytes)
12	  password: z
13	    .string()
14	    .min(8, 'Password must be at least 8 characters')
15	    .max(72, 'Password must be 72 characters or fewer')
16	    .regex(
17	      /^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)/,
18	      'Password must include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number',
19	    ),
20	  studioName: z.string().min(2, 'Studio name must be at least 2 characters').max(60),
21	})
22	
23	export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
24	  // Rate limit by IP
25	  const ip = getClientIp(request)
26	
27	  const { success, limit, remaining } = await signupRatelimit.limit(ip)
28	  if (!success) {
29	    return new Response('Too many signup attempts. Try again later.', {
30	      status: 429,
31	      headers: {
32	        'Retry-After': '60',
33	        'X-RateLimit-Limit': String(limit),
34	        'X-RateLimit-Remaining': '0',
35	      },
36	    })
37	  }
38	
39	  // Validate body
40	  const raw = await request.json().catch(() => null)
41	  const parsed = bodySchema.safeParse(raw)
42	  if (!parsed.success) {
43	    return Response.json({ error: parsed.error.format() }, { status: 400 })
44	  }
45	
46	  const admin = createServiceRoleClient()
47	
48	  // Use admin.createUser — no email sent, no rate limit. Safe because the user just
49	  // proved ownership by choosing a password. Re-enable email verification later via
50	  // a proper check-your-inbox flow once SMTP is wired up.
51	  const { data: userData, error: createError } = await admin.auth.admin.createUser({
52	    email: parsed.data.email,
53	    password: parsed.data.password,
54	    email_confirm: true,
55	    user_metadata: {
56	      studio_name: parsed.data.studioName,
57	      full_name: parsed.data.studioName,
58	    },
59	  })
60	
61	  if (createError) {
62	    logger.warn({ ip, errorCode: createError.status, message: createError.message }, 'auth.signup.failed')
63	    return Response.json(
64	      { error: createError.message },
65	      {
66	        status: 400,
67	        headers: {
68	          'X-RateLimit-Limit': String(limit),
69	          'X-RateLimit-Remaining': String(remaining),
70	        },
71	      },
72	    )
73	  }
74	
75	  const userId = userData.user?.id
76	  logger.info({ userId }, 'auth.signup.success')
77	
78	  // Create studio + owner membership using service-role client (bypasses RLS).
79	  // The handle_new_user trigger only creates profiles — we own studio provisioning here.
80	  if (userId) {
81	    try {
82	      const baseSlug = slugify(parsed.data.studioName) || 'studio'
83	      const slug = `${baseSlug}-${userId.slice(0, 6)}`
84	
85	      const { data: studio, error: studioError } = await admin
86	        .from('studios')
87	        .insert({ name: parsed.data.studioName, slug })
88	        .select('id')
89	        .single()
90	
91	      if (studioError) throw studioError
92	
93	      const { error: memberError } = await admin
94	        .from('studio_members')
95	        .insert({ studio_id: studio.id, user_id: userId, role: 'owner' })
96	
97	      if (memberError) throw memberError
98	
99	      logger.info({ userId, studioId: studio.id }, 'auth.signup.studio_provisioned')
100	    } catch (err) {
101	      logger.error({ userId, err }, 'auth.signup.studio_provision_failed')
102	      // Non-fatal — user can still sign in and complete onboarding
103	    }
104	  }
105	
106	  return Response.json({ ok: true })

12	/**
13	 * POST /api/billing/cancel
14	 * Schedules cancel_at_period_end = true via Dodo API.
15	 * Owner role required. Does NOT cancel immediately.
16	 *
17	 * M5: Does NOT write to local DB — the subscription.updated webhook from Dodo
18	 * is the source of truth. Writing optimistically before webhook confirmation
19	 * creates a divergence window if Dodo rejects the update asynchronously.
20	 */
21	export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
22	  const ip = getClientIp(req)
23	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
24	  if (!success) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'rate limit exceeded' }, { status: 429 })
25	
26	  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
27	  if (!auth) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
28	
29	  if (auth.role !== 'owner') {
30	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'owner role required' }, { status: 403 })
31	  }
32	
33	  const supabase = await createClient()
34	  const { data: sub } = await supabase
35	    .from('subscriptions')
36	    .select('id, dodo_subscription_id, status')
37	    .eq('studio_id', auth.studioId)
38	    .maybeSingle()
39	
40	  if (!sub?.dodo_subscription_id) {
41	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'no active subscription found' }, { status: 404 })
42	  }
43	
44	  if (sub.status === 'canceled') {
45	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'subscription is already cancelled' }, { status: 409 })
46	  }
47	
48	  try {
49	    // Only call Dodo API — do NOT write locally.
50	    // The subscription.updated webhook will flip the DB field once Dodo confirms.
51	    const updateParams: SubscriptionUpdateParams = { cancel_at_next_billing_date: true }
52	    await dodo.subscriptions.update(sub.dodo_subscription_id, updateParams)
53	
54	    await logAuditAction(
55	      auth.user.authId,
56	      'billing.subscription.cancel_requested',
57	      { type: 'studio', id: auth.studioId },
58	      { dodoSubscriptionId: sub.dodo_subscription_id },
59	      auth.studioId,
60	    )
61	
62	    // Return pending — UI should poll or rely on realtime subscription update from webhook
63	    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, pending: true, message: 'Cancellation queued — will take effect at period end' })
64	  } catch (err) {
65	    logger.error({ err, studioId: auth.studioId }, 'subscription cancel failed')
66	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'failed to cancel subscription' }, { status: 500 })
67	  }
68	}

15	  // Forward all headers (including cookies for auth) to the canonical endpoint

1	/**
2	 * POST /api/schedule/apply-template
3	 *
4	 * Applies a named schedule template to a target week.
5	 * Built-in templates: 'mon-fri-9to5', 'mon-sat-10to6', 'weekend-only'.
6	 * Custom templates: looked up from schedule_templates table (pending migration).
7	 */
8	import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
9	import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
10	import { authedRatelimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
11	import { getClientIp } from '@/lib/rate-limit/get-client-ip'
12	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
13	import { z } from 'zod'
14	
15	const ApplyTemplateSchema = z.object({
16	  template_id: z.string().min(1),  // built-in name or UUID
17	  target_week_start: z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/),
18	  artist_ids: z.array(z.string().uuid()).min(1),
19	})
20	
21	// Built-in templates: day_of_week (0=Sun) + time ranges
22	const BUILTIN_TEMPLATES: Record<string, { day_of_week: number; start_time: string; end_time: string }[]> = {
23	  'mon-fri-9to5': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((d) => ({ day_of_week: d, start_time: '09:00:00', end_time: '17:00:00' })),
24	  'mon-sat-10to6': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((d) => ({ day_of_week: d, start_time: '10:00:00', end_time: '18:00:00' })),
25	  'weekend-only': [0, 6].map((d) => ({ day_of_week: d, start_time: '10:00:00', end_time: '16:00:00' })),
26	}
27	
28	export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
29	  const ip = getClientIp(req)
30	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
31	  if (!success) return Response.json({ error: 'Rate limited' }, { status: 429 })
32	
33	  const supabase = await createClient()
34	
35	  const {
36	    data: { user },
37	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
38	  if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
39	
40	  const { data: member } = await supabase
41	    .from('studio_members')
42	    .select('role, studio_id')
43	    .eq('user_id', user.id)
44	    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
45	    .limit(1)
46	    .single()
47	  if (!member) return Response.json({ error: 'No membership' }, { status: 403 })
48	
49	  if (member.role !== 'owner' && member.role !== 'admin') {
50	    return Response.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 })
51	  }
52	
53	  let body: unknown
54	  try {
55	    body = await req.json()
56	  } catch {
57	    return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }, { status: 400 })
58	  }
59	
60	  const parsed = ApplyTemplateSchema.safeParse(body)
61	  if (!parsed.success) {
62	    return Response.json({ error: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 422 })
63	  }
64	
65	  const { template_id, target_week_start, artist_ids } = parsed.data
66	
67	  // Resolve template slots
68	  let templateSlots: { day_of_week: number; start_time: string; end_time: string }[]
69	
70	  if (BUILTIN_TEMPLATES[template_id]) {
71	    templateSlots = BUILTIN_TEMPLATES[template_id]!
72	  } else {
73	    // Look up custom template from schedule_templates table
74	    // Using raw select then casting because generated types may not include this table yet
75	    const { data: rawTemplate, error: templateError } = await supabase
76	      .from('schedule_templates')
77	      .select('id, slots')
78	      .eq('id', template_id)
79	      .eq('studio_id', member.studio_id)
80	      .single()
81	
82	    if (templateError || !rawTemplate) {
83	      return Response.json({ error: 'Template not found' }, { status: 404 })
84	    }
85	
86	    const customTemplate = rawTemplate as unknown as {
87	      id: string
88	      slots: { day_of_week: number; start_time: string; end_time: string }[]
89	    }
90	
91	    // slots is stored as JSONB: [{day_of_week, start_time, end_time}]
92	    const slots = customTemplate.slots
93	    if (!Array.isArray(slots) || slots.length === 0) {
94	      return Response.json({ error: 'Template has no slots defined' }, { status: 422 })
95	    }
96	    templateSlots = slots
97	  }
98	
99	  try {
100	    const newSlots = artist_ids.flatMap((artistId) =>
101	      templateSlots.map((slot) => ({
102	        studio_id: member.studio_id,
103	        artist_id: artistId,
104	        day_of_week: slot.day_of_week,
105	        start_time: slot.start_time,
106	        end_time: slot.end_time,
107	        effective_from: target_week_start,
108	        effective_until: null,
109	      })),
110	    )
111	
112	    const { error: insertError } = await supabase
113	      .from('artist_schedules')
114	      .insert(newSlots)
115	
116	    if (insertError) {
117	      logger.error({ error: insertError }, 'apply-template: insert failed')
118	      return Response.json({ error: 'Failed to apply template' }, { status: 500 })
119	    }
120	
121	    return Response.json({ data: { applied: newSlots.length } })
122	  } catch (err) {
123	    logger.error({ err }, 'apply-template: unexpected error')
124	    return Response.json({ error: 'Server error' }, { status: 500 })
125	  }
126	}
